decision.label_ru: Логичная композиция, связность и последовательность сочинения

included: absence of logical contradictions between parts of the essay
clear logical transitions between paragraphs and theses
conclusions that follow from the stated arguments
functional sequence and semantic cohesion of essay parts
excluded: mere paragraph formatting or equal paragraph length
a generic essay-quality or overall-writing identity

acceptance_reason: The final Task-27 route is Tier-A proven. FIPI K5 defines logicality through contradictions, transitions and conclusions. The current EGE taxonomy node candidate-052 is source-verified as essay composition/coherence, and the original Eksamio learner unit trains the same bounded logical-coherence operation with independent verification. The accepted semantic is therefore bounded to K5 logical coherence and does not absorb K7-K10 or generic essay quality.
